g.text: B: 4,096 prompt / 1,024 output tokens. A already returned its first token at t0.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: Timed work: 1,023 remaining A tokens + 1,024 B tokens = 2,047 output IDs.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: Dots: all 5 paired trials per policy; bars: medians. No confidence intervals or invented densities.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: Cooperative serial interleaving; no hardware overlap or SM reservation. Native MLX validates accuracy only.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: This is not an MLX speed comparison. Shorter A stalls may trade off against B's first-token latency.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: A maximum gap includes initial resumption. Stall threshold: 100 ms.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: Configured warmups per policy: 1. Cache reset: logical invalidation.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #536677

g.text: Setup and A's initial prefill are excluded; B's reset and all scheduling work are timed.
